syn_powerlaw_01.marginal_parametric: exponential with the stationary rate lam0/(1-n*) = 1
syn_powerlaw_01.assumptions: Lomax-Hawkes conditional law given the stored events: lambda(t) = lam0 + sum phi(t - t_j) over all stored events before the target; the stored events are treated as the full history (the generator centers timestamps at the first simulated event, so no earlier events exist). The finite simulation horizon (T_max = 50/80), the 5-500 length filter and the six-decimal rounding are ignored, i.e. the oracle is the uncensored conditional law of the process. History timestamps use the stored float64 values; targets follow the common evaluator (float32 differences). LL uses log density at max(y, 1e-6).

syn_powerlaw_02.marginal_parametric: exponential with the stationary rate lam0/(1-n*) = 0.571429
syn_powerlaw_02.assumptions: Lomax-Hawkes conditional law given the stored events: lambda(t) = lam0 + sum phi(t - t_j) over all stored events before the target; the stored events are treated as the full history (the generator centers timestamps at the first simulated event, so no earlier events exist). syn_corr_pareto_01.assumptions: Pareto-copula conditional law given the previous interval: the Gaussian score of the predecessor is recovered from the stored time_since_last_event of event i-1 (for the target at i = 1 this is the first stored interval, which equals the first generator draw), with the generator's probability clipping [1e-9, 1-1e-9] applied to the survival value; the six-decimal rounding of the stored predecessor is ignored (it perturbs the recovered score slightly, so the oracle is an infinitesimally noisy version of the exact one). The conditional CDF is F(t) = 0 below xmin, carries the generator's clipping atoms at xmin (u < 1e-9) and at tau_max = xmin * 1e-9^(-1/alpha) (u > 1 - 1e-9; conditional mass reported as upper_clip_atom_mass), and equals 1 at and beyond tau_max; the six-decimal rounding of the target is ignored. Targets below xmin (float32 rounding) contribute xmin - y to the CRPS; LL uses log density at max(y, 1e-6, xmin).

syn_exp_01.assumptions: No oracle: the per-sequence scale and memory of the correlated-exponential generator are not stored. Running mean = mean of the stored time_since_last_event values of events 0..i-1 (including the first stored interval), floored at 1e-6, as an exponential mean.
